title: Replace Vite production dashboard build with Bun.build
description: Replace Vite production building in src/dashboard/client/vite.config.ts with Bun.build. Preserve src/dashboard/client/index.html, src/dashboard/client/src/main.tsx, React JSX, CSS, asset imports, hashed assets, favicon, and the dist layout consumed by dashboardClientDir() and productionDashboardDir() in src/dashboard/server.ts. Preserve package scripts dashboard:build and build, including bun build --compile --asset src/dashboard/client/dist. Keep or replace dashboard:dev with an explicitly tested local watch workflow.
acceptance: dashboard:build produces the asset layout expected by productionDashboardDir and compiled binary tests.
Bun.build handles React entry points, CSS, asset hashing, and SPA fallback inputs used by the dashboard.

The development workflow decision is explicit: either (a) a Bun-native watch/HMR workflow is implemented and tested, or (b) Vite is retained as a dev-only dependency with its role documented in the migration plan. The production build path must not depend on Vite.
Bun 1.4 frozen install, tests, typecheck, Biome, build, and ledger validation pass.
notes: Execution inventory: package.json scripts; src/dashboard/client/vite.config.ts; src/dashboard/client/index.html; src/dashboard/client/src/main.tsx; src/dashboard/server.ts dashboardClientDir()/productionDashboardDir(); test/compiled-dashboard.test.ts. Required output is dist/index.html, dist/assets/*, and favicon assets that work in source and compiled executable modes. See docs/bun-native-stack-migration-plan.md.
